boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of California-Berkeley
boards.description: Ten distinct, under-21-safe food and drink stops with currently published late hours near UC Berkeley.

cards.title: Artichoke Basille's Pizza Berkeley
cards.subtitle: 2590 Durant Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: Check the posted day before heading over: the Durant Avenue shop lists service until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Durant Avenue pizza counter with the latest posted closing time in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Artichoke Basille's Pizza lists Berkeley hours of 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Artichoke Basille's Pizza Berkeley — Hours & Location
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Seniore's Pizza Berkeley
cards.subtitle: 2518 Durant Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: Use the Durant Avenue location’s posted schedule when planning a late pickup; it lists 5 p.m.–3 a.m. Monday through Saturday and closed Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Durant Avenue pizza stop with 3 a.m. published hours on six nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Seniore's Pizza lists its Berkeley location at 2518 Durant Ave and hours of 5 p.m.–3 a.m. Monday–Saturday; it is closed Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 5 p.m.–3 a.m. Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Gypsy's Trattoria Italiana
cards.subtitle: 2519 Durant Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: For an evening food run, consult the restaurant’s schedule: it lists daily midnight closing and later Friday–Saturday semester hours.
cards.short_summary: An Italian restaurant on Durant Avenue that publishes midnight daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Gypsy's Trattoria Italiana lists 2519 Durant Ave and daily 10 a.m.–midnight hours, with 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday hours during active semesters.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 10 a.m.–midnight daily; active-semester Friday and Saturday hours extend to 1 a.m. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Kingpin Donuts
cards.subtitle: 2521 Durant Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: Keep the address handy for a late dessert or pastry stop: Kingpin’s own site lists this Durant Avenue shop open daily until 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated donut shop that posts daily 2 a.m. closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Kingpin Donuts lists its address as 2521 Durant Avenue, Suite A, Berkeley and states that it is open daily from 7 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: daily, 7 a.m.–2 a.m. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Caffè Strada
cards.subtitle: 2300 College Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: Meet at the College and Bancroft corner when a nonalcoholic drink or bakery item fits the plan; its site posts midnight closing every day.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue café with posted midnight service and food items on its menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Caffè Strada lists 2300 College Ave and says it is open daily from 6 a.m. to midnight, with Sunday hours of 7 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: midnight closing daily; Sunday opens at 7 a.m. and other days at 6 a.m. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: SLIVER Pizzeria Telegraph
cards.subtitle: 2468 Telegraph Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: Use the Telegraph location page, not a chainwide listing, to check the day’s schedule; it publishes 10:30 p.m. closing Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Telegraph Avenue SLIVER location with late-week evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: SLIVER Pizzeria’s Telegraph location at 2468 Telegraph Ave lists closing at 10:30 p.m. Tuesday–Sunday and 8 p.m. Monday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 10:30 p.m. closing Tuesday–Sunday; 8 p.m. Monday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: SLIVER Pizzeria Shattuck
cards.subtitle: 2174 Shattuck Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: For a downtown option, consult the Shattuck page before leaving; it lists this separate SLIVER location open through 10:30 p.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Berkeley SLIVER location that posts daily 10:30 p.m. closing.
cards.evidence_claim: SLIVER Pizzeria’s Shattuck location at 2174 Shattuck Ave lists 11 a.m.–10:30 p.m. hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Uji Time Dessert Berkeley
cards.subtitle: 2575 Telegraph Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: Save this Telegraph Avenue dessert stop for Friday or Saturday evenings, when its location page lists 10:30 p.m. closing; other days end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Telegraph Avenue Japanese-dessert shop with 10:30 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Uji Time Dessert lists its Berkeley location at 2575 Telegraph Ave and Friday–Saturday hours of 1:30 p.m.–10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 10:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday; 9:30 p.m. Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday; 8 p.m. Tuesday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Yogurt Park
cards.subtitle: 2433 Durant Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: Choose this Durant Avenue frozen-yogurt stop when you need a dessert option that remains open to 11 p.m.; check the site for any day-specific change.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated frozen-yogurt shop with a posted 11 p.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Yogurt Park lists its address as 2433 Durant Ave, Berkeley and publishes hours of noon to 11 p.m. for the current day.
cards.access_notes: The official site currently displays noon–11 p.m.; confirm the schedule before travel because the page presents current-day hours.

cards.title: Thai Basil
cards.subtitle: 2519-F Durant Ave, Berkeley
cards.notes: Use the listed Durant Avenue address for an evening meal; the Berkeley visitor bureau’s business page posts daily hours through 10:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated Thai restaurant on Durant Avenue with daily 10:30 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Berkeley’s Thai Basil listing gives the address as 2519-F Durant Ave and states daily hours of 11 a.m.–10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: daily, 11 a.m.–10:30 p.m. Confirm before travel.
